verdicts.explanation: The paper states that LGPS 'established that an inorganic solid electrolyte can achieve room-temperature ionic conductivity on the order of 10-2 S∙cm-1', so the material, value, unit, and room-temperature condition match. The value is a prior-work statement in a review, so literature_cited is the right origin, and all secondary fields are null as the paper gives none for LGPS here.

The ~2 × 10-3 S·cm-1 value is an upper bound ('up to') for the oxyhalide antiperovskite family, stated for 'Li3OCl and Li3OCl1-xBrx' together, so it is not attributable to the Br-substituted composition specifically. The material assignment is therefore not supported by the paper.
